# Pocket Dev

> Continue AI conversations across devices, connect your team's authorized AI capabilities and develop projects from one browser-based workspace.

Free, self-hosted, open source. Node.js 22+, exact npm package @anisirji/pocket-dev; pocket-dev start. No mobile app or required Pocket account. 3.0.0 is unpublished; verify installed version and platform. Experimental local Antigravity and Copilot. No bundled MCP server.

## Features

- [AI Chat](https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#chat-with-claude-code-codex-antigravity-and-copilot): Continue Claude Code and Codex conversations across devices, switch providers and respond to approvals.
- [AI & Resource Sharing](https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev/blob/main/docs/UNIFIED_CONNECTIONS.md): Connect authorized computers and choose a compatible shared AI source while keeping your project on its workspace computer.
- [Workspace](https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#project-workspace): Use a VS Code-inspired editor, files, chat, terminal and Git in one workspace.
- [Smart Notifications](https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev/blob/main/docs/FEATURES.md#smart-notifications): Get a short sound and temporary alert when a task completes, fails or needs attention — no notification inbox.
- [Remote Screen & Control](https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev/blob/main/docs/FEATURES.md#remote-screen--control): View an authorized computer's screen and choose displays or quality where supported; optional Mac input needs local approval.
- [Camera & Audio](https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev/blob/main/docs/CAMERA.md): View the host camera, listen to its microphone and use push to talk through its speakers with authorization.
- [Developer Tools](https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md): Use terminals, files, Git, development ports and device-to-device messages.
- [Computer Management](https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#open-apps-health-and-power): See available health information, manage running apps and use supported power controls.
- [Connected & Self-hosted](https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev/blob/main/docs/UNIFIED_CONNECTIONS.md): Connect locally or enable optional remote access; authorize devices with QR codes and manage permissions.
- [Simple Setup & Help](https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev/blob/main/docs/SETUP.md): Install with npm, configure through guided Admin setup and use contextual instructions and diagnostics.
